title: Chemical Plant Explosion (Texas)
event: A major chemical plant fire occurred in Texas causing regional evacuations and hazardous air quality alerts.
documents: Emergency crews arrived at the Deer Park chemical complex at 3:15 PM following reports of structural damage in the hydrocarbon processing unit.

Preliminary internal investigation logs confirmed that a critical pressure relief valve failure on Tank 4 failed to vent accumulating pressurized gas, triggering an immediate catastrophic rupture and fireball.
Nearby schools and residential blocks within a 3-mile radius were issued shelter-in-place warnings due to elevated benzene levels.

options.A: A sudden thunderstorm damaged municipal power transmission lines across the county.
options.B: A pressure valve failure caused an explosion and rupture in Tank 4.
options.C: A scheduled labor union strike halted automatic maintenance routines.

rationale: Document 2 directly identifies the pressure relief valve failure on Tank 4 triggering the rupture and fireball.

title: Chemical Plant Explosion (Multi-Cause Confluence)
event: A major chemical plant fire occurred in Texas causing regional evacuations and hazardous air quality alerts.
documents: Investigation findings revealed that a pressure relief valve on Tank 4 suffered mechanical jamming under high vapor pressure.
Simultaneously, a complete failure of the emergency deluge sprinkler system deprived the unit of cooling water after automated backup pumps were shut down during an unlogged maintenance procedure.
The compound failure of pressure venting and backup water cooling caused rapid thermal runaway within 18 minutes.

options.A: Severe regional lightning strikes knocked out electrical substation feeds.
options.B: A pressure relief valve jammed and ruptured Tank 4 under intense pressure.
options.C: The emergency deluge sprinkler cooling system failed to activate due to shutdown backup pumps.

rationale: Both the relief valve jamming (B) and the emergency cooling deluge system failure (C) acted as joint causal catalysts.

title: Chemical Plant Explosion (Subtle Distractor Test)
event: A major chemical plant fire occurred in Texas causing regional evacuations and hazardous air quality alerts.
documents: Forensic investigators ruled out any structural or mechanical flaws in Tank 4 or its pressure valves, which passed ultrasonic integrity tests.
Instead, an offsite high-voltage electrical transformer explosion arc-flashed into an external storage pipeline, sparking the blaze.
Local labor representatives confirmed all plant operators were on duty and followed emergency shutdown protocols.

options.A: An offsite electrical transformer explosion arc-flashed into an external fuel line.
options.B: A pressure relief valve failure triggered an internal explosion in Tank 4.
options.C: Plant operators abandoned monitoring consoles during a labor dispute.

rationale: Counterfactual evidence explicitly rules out Tank 4 (Option B) and attributes the cause to the external transformer arc flash (Option A).

title: South Korea Parliamentary Impeachment
event: South Korea's parliament voted overwhelmingly to impeach President Yoon Suk Yeol in an emergency legislative session.
documents: On the night of December 3, President Yoon Suk Yeol made a sudden televised broadcast declaring emergency martial law, accusing opposition parties of anti-state activities.
Immediately following the decree, military helicopters landed at the National Assembly complex and hundreds of armed special forces soldiers attempted to storm the legislative chambers.
Lawmakers broke through police cordons and climbed perimeter fences to enter the chamber, voting 190-0 to nullify the martial law decree within hours.

options.A: President Yoon's cabinet ministers submitted their resignations en masse.
options.B: Hundreds of armed soldiers stormed the National Assembly building to halt parliamentary proceedings.
options.C: Tens of thousands of civic protesters assembled peacefully in Gwanghwamun Square.
options.D: President Yoon Suk Yeol abruptly declared emergency martial law and deployed military forces to parliament.

rationale: Both the martial law decree (D) and the armed storming of parliament (B) constituted the unconstitutional triggers for impeachment.

title: Global Cloud Hypervisor Outage
event: Over 14,000 corporate cloud instances crashed in synchronized failure across European datacenters.
documents: A kernel-level security telemetry update released by a global cybersecurity vendor contained an out-of-bounds memory read error in its driver module.
When host machines loaded the signed update at 04:09 UTC, Windows kernel exceptions triggered immediate blue screen crash loops across all client virtual machines.
Network routing telemetry showed no external DDoS attack packets or unauthorized packet injections during the incident window.

options.A: A kernel-level cybersecurity telemetry driver update triggered fatal out-of-bounds memory crashes.
options.B: A state-sponsored distributed denial-of-service attack flooded datacenter edge gateways.
options.C: Undersea fiber optic cables connecting London and Amsterdam were severed by fishing trawlers.

rationale: Document 1-2 explicitly confirm the driver update memory flaw as the direct cause, while ruling out DDoS attacks.

title: FinTech Payment Gateway Ransomware & Data Theft
event: A transnational payment processing hub halted all card authorizations and reported unauthorized database exfiltration.
documents: Adversaries leveraged an unpatched zero-day remote code execution vulnerability in the public-facing API portal to obtain initial web shell access.
Forensic logs revealed that stolen administrator credentials without multi-factor authentication allowed the attackers to move laterally into encrypted cardholder databases.
Network engineers detected data staging servers transmitting 4 terabytes of compressed archives to bulletproof hosting IP ranges.

options.A: Attackers exploited an unpatched zero-day remote code execution flaw in the web API gateway.
options.B: A localized power substation surge damaged the main SAN storage arrays.
options.C: Compromised administrator credentials lacking multi-factor authentication enabled lateral database intrusion.
options.D: A software licensing dispute led third-party payment providers to revoke API keys.

rationale: Initial entry occurred via the zero-day API exploit (A) and lateral database expansion occurred via single-factor admin credentials (C).

title: Commercial Airliner Fleet Emergency Grounding
event: Civil aviation authorities ordered the immediate grounding and mandatory inspection of all Model-7X passenger jets nationwide.
documents: A scheduled commercial flight experienced sudden in-flight cabin depressurization when an unbolted emergency exit door plug detached at 16,000 feet.
Post-incident inspections by federal investigators revealed missing retaining bolts and recurring fatigue micro-cracks in fuselage door fittings on multiple sister aircraft.
Regulatory inspectors cited multiple manufacturing quality lapses at subcontractor assembly plants where door assemblies were installed without documentation.

options.A: An emergency exit door plug blew out during flight due to missing retaining bolts.
options.B: A heavy blizzard grounded air operations across five major Midwestern hub airports.
options.C: Federal investigators detected recurring structural micro-cracks in door fittings across multiple sister airframes.

rationale: The blowout incident (A) combined with systematic sister airframe micro-cracks (C) drove the fleetwide grounding directive.

title: Metropolitan Power Grid Cascade Failure
event: Over four million residents lost electrical power across the metropolitan corridor during an extreme summer heatwave.
documents: Record temperatures reaching 108°F caused regional air conditioning power demand to hit unprecedented peak levels of 78,000 megawatts.
At 4:40 PM, a key high-voltage transmission line sagged into overgrown vegetation and short-circuited, tripping protective relays.
Simultaneously, a cyber breach on supervisory control software delayed automated load-balancing rerouting commands between substations.

options.A: Record high temperatures triggered historic peak electrical demand for air conditioning.
options.B: A high-voltage transmission line sagged into trees and tripped regional substation relays.
options.C: A cyber intrusion compromised supervisory control systems, disabling automated grid load shedding.
options.D: A coastal tsunami damaged cooling seawater intake pumps at a nuclear facility.

rationale: Unprecedented air-conditioning demand (A), physical line sag short-circuit (B), and disabled SCADA load-balancing (C) all converged to cause the collapse.

title: Pharmaceutical Phase III Trial Suspension
event: A leading biotechnology firm halted Phase III trials and recalled batches of investigational peptide drug Bio-91.
documents: The clinical trial had enrolled over 1,200 patients suffering from autoimmune rheumatoid arthritis across twelve clinical centers.
During month 4 biomarker monitoring, routine toxicology screens uncovered acute elevated hepatic enzyme levels indicating drug-induced liver injury in 6% of active-arm participants.
The Independent Data Safety Monitoring Board issued an urgent directive advising trial sponsors to cease administration immediately.

options.A: Patient recruitment failed to meet minimum statistical enrollment quotas.
options.B: The pharmaceutical patent rights expired without viable renewal options.
options.C: Safety monitors discovered acute drug-induced liver toxicity and elevated hepatic enzymes in trial participants.
options.D: Competitor manufacturers released a cheaper generic equivalent medication.

rationale: Severe drug-induced liver injury discovered during biomarker toxicology screens (C) prompted the immediate halt.

title: Orbital Rocket Launch Abort at T-minus 12 Seconds
event: Mission flight controllers declared an automated pad abort for heavy-lift rocket Titan-IX twelve seconds prior to ignition.
documents: Ground telemetry sensors registered abnormal liquid oxygen turbopump chilldown pressure variations in Stage 1 Engine 3.
Concurrently, the automated umbilical tower arm failed to retract and lock in its safe launch corridor position.
Range safety weather radar confirmed calm wind vectors and zero lightning risk across the launch complex.

options.A: Sensor telemetry detected abnormal turbopump chilldown pressure fluctuations in Engine 3.
options.B: Severe high-altitude wind shear exceeded aerodynamic launch envelope limits.
options.C: Loss of primary satellite command communications with mission control.
options.D: The launch umbilical tower arm failed to retract and clear the rocket trajectory.

rationale: Both the cryogenic engine turbopump pressure anomaly (A) and the unretracted umbilical tower arm (D) triggered the pad abort safety loop.

title: Stock Exchange Algorithmic Flash Freeze
event: The central equities exchange triggered an unscheduled 45-minute circuit-breaker market halt.
documents: Market surveillance monitors detected an errant high-frequency algorithmic quoting loop generating 3.8 million cancellation orders per second.
The order book congestion caused packet drops across matching engine memory queues, introducing asymmetrical order latency.
Regulators confirmed no macro-economic rate announcements or sovereign debt defaults occurred during the trading session.

options.A: The Federal Reserve announced an emergency inter-meeting interest rate hike.
options.B: A rogue high-frequency algorithmic loop flooded matching engines with millions of quote cancellations.
options.C: An optical fiber disruption severed trans-Atlantic communication between London and New York.
options.D: A global sovereign debt default triggered widespread institutional margin calls.

rationale: The flood of algorithmic cancellations overloading the matching engine queues (B) was the sole technical cause for the trading halt.

title: Robotaxi Fleet Emergency Stop in Downtown
event: A commercial fleet of forty autonomous robotaxis came to an abrupt halt simultaneously in city center intersections.
documents: Urban construction crews deployed highly reflective non-standard orange vinyl barriers and flashing stroboscopic work lights at 6th and Pine.
The vehicle perception models experienced simultaneous semantic segmentation hallucination, misclassifying the strobe reflections as dynamic phantom pedestrians.
A cellular base station outage also degraded real-time remote human teleoperation backup connectivity across the 4-block grid.

options.A: A sudden winter blizzard froze ultrasonic distance sensors across all vehicles.
options.B: Perception neural networks suffered vision hallucination from construction strobes, detecting phantom pedestrians.
options.C: A cellular base station outage disabled real-time teleoperation backup connectivity.
options.D: Rival taxi unions physically obstructed vehicle navigation pathways.

rationale: Vision model hallucination from strobe lights (B) paired with the teleoperation connection failure (C) forced the fleet into failsafe emergency stop.
